d:
shri shiv mahimn stotr | Shri Shiv Mahimna Stotram | bhagvan shiv ki stuti
Om nam shivay! har har mahadev!
Bhagvan shiv ki mahima ka gungan karne vala divy shri shiv mahimn stotr shraddha evan bhaktibhav se sunen aur devon ke dev mahadev ki aaradhna karen.
Shiv mahimn stotr bhagvan shiv ki stuti men rachit ek atyant prasiddh sanskrit stotr hai. iski pratyek stuti mahadev ki anant mahima, divy svarup aur unki asim shakti ka gungan karti hai.
Bhagvan bholenath ki bhakti men lin hokar shiv mahimn stotr ka shravan karen aur apne man men shraddha, shanti evan sakaratmak bhavon ka sanchar karen.
